method: Predeclared targeted screens: 40 setups per matchup, every candidate seat rotated against the named incumbent or independent heuristic. Hive uses recorded six-ply seeded legal openings. Ticket to Ride retains manual supply adjudication. Approximate 95% paired-t intervals use only complete setup groups. Incomplete groups may cause selection bias; these are not equal-time comparisons. No promotion follows without the separately declared gate. Final decision: retain Hive safeguards for immediate tactical correctness without a confirmed general strength claim; Ticket to Ride planning-v2 remains research-only and the browser incumbent is unchanged because the completeness gate failed.
